title: Hip-Hop Evolution - "Grandmaster Flash" The Origin of Scratching on Vinyl
speaker: The Necrogeddon
zh: 【The Necrogeddon】嘻哈進化論－「閃電大師」黑膠唱片刮盤的起源（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Most DJs, they concentrated their efforts on the tone arm.
cues.en: Most DJs, they concentrated their efforts on the tone arm.
cues.zh: 大多數DJ，他們把精力集中在唱臂上。

cues.text: It would be totally sloppy off beat.
cues.en: It would be totally sloppy off beat.

cues.text: And I seen a lot of that.
cues.en: And I seen a lot of that.
cues.zh: 我看到了很多這樣的事情。

cues.text: I knew there has to be a better way.
cues.en: I knew there has to be a better way.
cues.zh: 我知道一定有更好的方法。

cues.text: And after trying many different things,
cues.en: And after trying many different things,

cues.en: I said to myself, I have absolute control of the record.

cues.text: But the taboo thing was,
cues.en: But the taboo thing was,

cues.text: you're not supposed to touch the middle of the vinyl.
cues.en: you're not supposed to touch the middle of the vinyl.
cues.zh: 你不應該觸控乙烯基的中間。

cues.text: DJs are going to hate you.
cues.en: DJs are going to hate you.

cues.en: I decided that this is the only way to do this.
cues.zh: 我決定這是唯一的方法。

cues.text: And then what I did was so that I could find the break quicker.
cues.en: And then what I did was so that I could find the break quicker.
cues.zh: 然後我所做的就是為了更快找到突破口。

cues.text: I took a crayon and I would make a circular mark
cues.en: I took a crayon and I would make a circular mark
cues.zh: 我拿了一支蠟筆，做了一個圓形標記

cues.text: where the break lived.
cues.en: where the break lived.

cues.en: So the circular mark is where the break lived.
cues.zh: 所以圓形標記就是中斷所在的地方。

cues.text: And the other mark is the intro to the break.
cues.en: And the other mark is the intro to the break.
cues.zh: 另一個標記是休息的介紹。

cues.text: So what I would do is count how many times
cues.en: So what I would do is count how many times
